name: Jerry☆Nonnon
source:
A cosmic wraith with jellyfish features and self-proclaimed most beautiful idol in the Milky Way Galaxy. She happened to see a human idol program being broadcasted on Galaxy news and became immediately fascinated.

She wants to create a world that replaces fighting with listening to her songs. She is traveling across the universe doing business by forcing people to listen to her singing.  Like an idol, she has a bright and cheerful personality that changes her expressions from goofy to cute and childish.

Her songs when heard live instead of over the air have the power to captivate not just human males but males of all species. She is very protective of her fans and is never rough with the males. With her special skill, she is gentle during sex. 

Her tentacles do not have suction cups, rather they look more like anemones. Some of her tentacles can transform into onaholes to perfectly match the shape of the male organ. The inside of the tentacles, which are specialized for squeezing semen, will give you a crazy amount of pleasure.
